name: @dub/app-health-monitor
description: app-health-monitor — free-tier死活監視. A DO-alarm-driven (no cron) hourly poller that checks each frontend app can open (SPA root 200 + all built JS/CSS chunks exist) and each backend service /health is ok, and alerts admins in-app when a target is down (flapping-suppressed: N consecutive failures to alert, recovery to clear).
